relationships.subject: nitroglycerin
relationships.evidence_quote: Repetitive intermittent NTG administration over 9 days produced significant time- and dose-dependent chronic basal mechanical hyperalgesia

key_findings: Chronic NTG (10 mg/kg s.c. every 2 d x5) in rats produced hyperalgesia, TNC neuroinflammation, CGRP/c-Fos increase and NF-κB activation, reversed by ibuprofen.
NTG increased BBB permeability (altered RAGE, LRP1, AQP4, MFSD2A) allowing peripheral IL-17A to reach the medulla and drive microglia-mediated neuroinflammation.
